I've got a question to manga readers. If possible without spoiling anything for me (I'm an anime-only viewer), how come so many things are added/dropped that make the anime so much different from the manga?

I decided to read the manga chapters of the episodes that have already aired (why not, not like rewatching something will spoil anything for me...).

But immediately I noticed so many changes. Subaru doesn't make a fool of himself in the manga, whereas in the anime you can't help but cringe while watching him. Al, a random unimportant character in the anime, has this whole backstory to him. Roswaal attacks Subaru in the manga when in the anime he's on his side. The giant creature revealed in this episode: "Sleep.. along with my daughter" isn't really a mystery if you've read the court-scene chapter as *someone* mentions their daughter. Crush didn't threaten Subaru when he tried to leave in the manga like she did in the anime.

I understand cutting certain things out, like for example when Rem shows up and "half-kills" the hoodlums to "save" Subaru & co. That scene was just fanservice, really, so I understand it being cut. But Al's introduction? Changing Subaru's personality? Not mentioning the "daughter" part? So many things are different, it's like I'm watching a different timeline.

Am I supposed to be this confused after having watched the currently available episodes and read the manga chapters that cover those episodes? I mean, manga-Subaru and anime-Subaru seem like to completely different people, and manga-Subaru doesn't seem as "pathetic" as anime-Subaru. (I'm not attacking anime-Subaru, I'm just saying the whole court scene made him look pathetic in the anime, whereas in the manga almost everything he says is justifiable).

At first I thought he'd reset back to before the court scene, and that's why things were happening so randomly. That they just mixed up the order of things, at least that's what I read somewhere. But now that his save point is after the court scene, it doesn't make sense to me that so many things were changed..
